server.name: thewalletaudit
server.title: The Wallet Audit
server.instructions: Data on US consumer credit cards, hand-sourced from issuer terms by The Wallet Audit. Money is whole US dollars. A field with status not_recorded has no value in the catalog: that does not mean the card lacks the feature. An insurance level of unconfirmed means the same, and so does an empty insurance list. Every card carries provenance: the issuer page, the date the card was last checked against issuer documents, a review_due_on date after which that check should not be relied on, and not_checked, the areas that check could not confirm. partially_verified means not_checked is not empty, so values in those areas are unconfirmed. not_verified means no recorded check. Verdicts and credit tiers are editorial estimates. A credit default of 0 means no use is assumed, not that the credit is worthless, so call estimate_value with real usage before weighing credits. Rankings use the earn multiplier times the card's best realistic cents per point and never consider affiliate status. The welcome_bonus field is not served. Free text such as services and credit descriptions may still mention a sign-up offer, which may be out of date, so confirm any offer with the issuer. Use find_cards to get card ids.

tools.name: find_cards
tools.title: Find cards
tools.description: Search the catalog by name, issuer or rewards program and get card ids for the other tools. Returns at most limit cards plus total_matches and next_offset, so you can tell when there are more. Omit query to list every card for an issuer.

tools.name: get_card
tools.title: Get card
tools.description: One card's fees, rates, credits, earn rates, redemption values, insurance and perks, with provenance. Heavy sections (credit tips, timeline, transfer partner list, services, additional cards, removed credits) are omitted unless requested in sections; omitted_sections lists what was left out. Rate and fee fields are {status, value}: not_recorded means the catalog has no value, not that the fee is zero.

tools.name: rank_by_category
tools.title: Rank cards by category
tools.description: Rank cards for a spending category by effective return per dollar: the earn multiplier times the card's best realistic cents per point (percent rates are used as stated). With card_ids, ranks only those cards and applies points pooling between cards that share a points account, as the site's My Cards view does; without it, ranks the whole catalog with no pooling. Ties go to the lower annual fee, then name. If fewer than 3 cards have a real bonus, the remaining top slots are filled with flat-rate cards marked is_fallback. Ignores spending caps, activation requirements and sign-up offers.

tools.name: estimate_value
tools.title: Estimate card value
tools.description: A card's statement credits and cash-like perks at your expected annual use, minus its annual fee. Pass credit_overrides with what you expect to use: without them most credits count as $0, because the catalog assumes no use, not because they are worthless. credits_at_zero reports how many. Overrides are clamped to each credit's advertised maximum and reported. Excludes points earning, lounge access, insurance, status perks and sign-up offers.
